description: Add an email to the developer's account (it stays pending until its inbox owner clicks the confirmation link), or resend that confirmation. Removing emails and changing the primary one are done in the web dashboard. `update_stripe_email` points the Stripe customer (where the Pro receipts go) at the primary address: when neblla_developer_profile says `stripeEmailDiffers`. It never touches their payout account, which is theirs in Stripe.

email.description: The address, for add and resend_confirmation
